C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION.Summary: Deterministic failure localization (D8): given expected V-M-* markers and an observed run log, report the first divergent block and the module that failed — or AbsenceValue with a reason — never a stack-trace stand-in for a question the evidence did not settle.
C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION.Problem:
When verification fails, a stack trace reports where execution blew up. The first divergent block reports where the flow started going wrong — frequently different. D8 restores that join: expected marker sequence from the verification entry, observed sequence from the run, first index at which they diverge.
At fe3aaa4 both sides of that join do not exist. Expected does: collectExactEvidence walks Marker children in document order into requiredLogMarkers (projections.ts:873-880, query/core.ts:189). Observed does not: health.ts:91-99 checks each marker with hasRuntimeMarkerEvidence (project-utils.ts:320-351), a static scan of source text for an emission statement — not a record of what a run emitted, in what order. No production path scrapes markers from command stdout, test output, or a log file into a sequence (A41.2 corr 93).
firstDivergentBlock(expected, observed) needs observed. Building the comparator without an input contract is the defect this re-derivation exists to prevent (A41.3).
Self-review is a localization source only for its mechanized subset (D8): scope, test-weakening, backward-compat. Phase 6 shipped those as family-B review.* codes plus hunk coverage, counterpart joins, and five family-A pattern detectors. Step 7.5.4's test was unwritable until those codes existed; A41.5 names which are admissible and which are not.
Flake classification already ships (classifyFlakeFromEvidence, grace-cursor.ts:1327-1367). D8 requires flaky results classified rather than pooled into localization signal. Phase 7 consumes the classifier; it does not rebuild it (A41.2 corr 98).
ngrace verification is find|show only (grace-verification.ts) — a read-only query surface. Localization belongs there as a query answer, not as a fourth issue catalog (D14, A41.2 corr 95).

Goals.Goal: Pure sequence tools: parseObservedMarkers(logText, expected) and firstDivergentBlock, with unit cases for each axis A40.2 forces — divergence at 0, mid, end, observed shorter, observed longer, identical, plus empty sides (A41.7 step 7.5.1).

Observed sequence primary path is agent-supplied log (--log and/or stdin), per A41.3 recommendation (2). The absence path is sharp: missing, unreadable, empty, or stack-trace-only logs produce AbsenceValue, never a frame-derived divergence index (A41.2 corr 102, §7.7).

Optional opt-in execution (A41.3 route 1) only if the maintainer admits it: same pure scrape over spawnShellCommand output, never default-on. If deferred, recorded as deferred, not silently dropped (A12.4).
Module join from failing test path via existing V-M-* testFiles and governed linkedModuleIds (A41.2 corr 97). Ungoverned path is absence, not a guess.
Reuse AbsenceValue / AbsenceVerdict (grace-cursor.ts:69-74). No second absence vocabulary (A41.2 corr 99, anti-pattern 5).

Review findings: only review.scope-outside-write-scope, review.test-assertion-weakened, and review.compat-new-error may appear as secondary process context. All other review.* codes excluded, table-driven against the real catalog (A41.5). None replaces the marker-sequence answer.
Surface as ngrace verification localize (read-only query). Consume from ngrace-fix with minimal skill text; mirror byte-identical (D15, §12.2). Writes nothing (F1).

Constraints.Constraint: Pending maintainer answer to A41.3 (observed-sequence source). Stage 2 does not begin until that answer and this spec are approved.
No new runtime dependencies. Surgical diffs only (§0.1).
src/lint/core.ts does not learn about localization. No localize.* catalog without an amendment that says so (D14, A41.2 corr 95).
ngrace verification localize does not author status, Verdicts, Decisions, or archive paths (F1, invariant 8).
Do not rebuild classifyFlakeFromEvidence or invent a parallel flake enum (A41.2 corr 98).
Do not present a stack trace as the divergence point under any path (§7.7.1, A41.2 corr 102).
Static health.required-log-marker-not-found remains the static check; localization does not replace or silence it (A41.2 corr 93 vs route 3).
Skill edits under skills/ngrace/ are mirrored to plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ in the same commit (§12.2).

Standing rule 10 (A30.6): localization answers are query-scoped and ephemeral to the invocation unless a later decision records them. Do not invent a ledger section mid-phase without stating scope first.
A40.2: a control is only evidence about the axis it varies. Six comparator axes are six cases, not one.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Making static source-marker presence the localization answer (A41.3 route 3 rejected).
Owning test execution by default, or widening what the binary runs without an explicit opt-in the maintainer admitted (A41.3, §5.2).
Rebuilding flake classification, the attempt log, or the review surface.
Feeding family-A pattern findings or counterpart joins into localization as divergence points (A41.5, D8 judgment half).
Making lint depend on run state or emit localization / review.* / gate.* codes (D14).
Inventing a seventeenth track-level design decision (D1–D16 stand) (§12.5).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-OBSERVED-FROM-LOG: A41.3 / A41.2 corr 93. Observed markers come from a caller-supplied log (--log and/or stdin) as the primary path, unless the maintainer answers A41.3 otherwise. Discriminating negative: with no log and no admitted opt-in run, the command emits AbsenceValue and does not invent an observed sequence from source text.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-COMPARATOR-AXES: A41.2 corr 102 / A40.2 / §7.5.1. firstDivergentBlock covers divergence at 0, mid, end, observed shorter, observed longer, and identical (null), each as its own unit case. Empty expected and empty observed are covered.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-NO-STACK-AS-DIVERGENCE: §7.7.1 / A41.2 corr 102. A fixture whose log is only a stack trace (no expected markers) produces no divergence index and never labels a stack frame as the first divergent block.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-ABSENCE-VALUE: A41.2 corr 99 / D5. Marker-less V-M-*, missing log, and ungoverned test path each emit AbsenceValue with reason. No second absence vocabulary. Empty-marker case is not a confident answer (§7.7.2).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-MODULE-JOIN: A41.2 corr 97. A failing test path listed on a V-M-* entry or linked to a module resolves to that module; a path in neither map is absence, not a guessed M-*.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-REVIEW-ADMISSIBILITY: A41.5 / D8 / A41.2 corr 101. Table-driven test: only review.scope-outside-write-scope, review.test-assertion-weakened, and review.compat-new-error may appear as secondary process context. Every other code in REVIEW_CATALOG is excluded from localization output as a source. None of the three substitutes for the marker-sequence answer.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-FLAKE-CONSUME: A41.2 corr 98 / D8. classifyFlakeFromEvidence is imported, not reimplemented. flaky → no causal divergence claim for that fail; unable-to-determine → no flake claim; retry → localization still allowed when a log is present. One fixture per verdict.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-QUERY-SURFACE: A41.2 corr 95 / D14 / F1. ngrace verification localize is registered on the verification query surface, returns structured text/JSON, and writes nothing. No new issue catalog. runLint over a project with localization available still emits no localize.* / review.* / gate.* from this change.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-FIX-SKILL: A41.2 corr 100 / D15. ngrace-fix consumes the command on a short path; packaged mirror is byte-identical; token/line delta reported in the phase report.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit tests for six comparator axes, absence paths, A41.5 review-code exclusion table, and flake verdict treatments; integration test for ngrace verification localize over a temp project with a synthetic log; stack-trace-only fixture produces no divergence index; root lint 0 errors with C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION present; skill mirror byte-identical; no writes from the localize command.

Assumptions.Assumption: Maintainer accepts A41.3 recommendation: (2) primary log/stdin path, with (1) opt-in run optional in the same phase or deferred. If rejected, amend A41 and this spec before plan.xml.
A41.5's hunk-uncovered and family-A exclusions stand unless the maintainer amends D8's mechanized subset when answering A41.3.
v1 does not auto-invoke ngrace review to load process context; admitted codes appear only when the caller supplies findings or not at all (A41.9 preference).
